discription: A simple Frequency Modulation (FM) synthesizer with an ADSR envelope, allowing control over carrier and modulator ratios and modulation index.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, carRatio=1, modRatio=1, modIndex=1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var carrierFreq = freq * carRatio;    var modulatorFreq = freq * modRatio;    var modulator = SinOsc.ar(modulatorFreq) * (modulatorFreq * modIndex);    sig = SinOsc.ar(carrierFreq + modulator) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
